title: Wi-Fi Router faulty in Boys Hostel Block-B (3rd Floor)
description: The Access Point on 3rd floor corridor has been blinking red since yesterday evening. Over 40 students across rooms 301 to 324 have no internet connectivity for online classes and assignment submissions.

timeline.title: Complaint Registered
timeline.note: Complaint filed with High priority by Aman Verma.

timeline.title: Reviewed by Warden Office
timeline.note: Forwarded to IT & Network Services Helpdesk.

timeline.title: Technician Dispatched
timeline.note: Assigned to Suresh Nair. New Cisco AP has been issued from store. Installation underway.

comments.author: Rohit Kumar
comments.text: Same issue here, facing problems with project submission today! Please resolve soon.

comments.author: Suresh Nair
comments.text: We are replacing the PoE switch on the 3rd floor. Should be up by 3:00 PM.

title: Water Cooler cooling unit broken & tap leaking in Main Library
description: The water cooler near reading hall 2 is dispensing warm water and there is continuous water leakage on the floor which might cause someone to slip.

timeline.title: Assigned to Maintenance
timeline.note: Work order generated for tap replacement and compressor check.

timeline.title: Issue Resolved
timeline.note: Replaced faulty washer, fixed tap seal, and refilled coolant. Chilled water functional now.

feedback.comment: Quick turnaround! The water is chilled now and floor is cleaned.

title: Hostel Mess Dinner Food Quality & Hygiene Concerns
description: In yesterday's dinner (dal and paneer), the food was undercooked and chapattis were burnt. Many students complained of stomach ache. Immediate inspection by food safety committee requested.

timeline.title: Mess Committee Meeting Called
timeline.note: Caterer summoned for emergency hygiene inspection at 11:00 AM.

comments.author: Arjun Patel
comments.text: Mess committee will inspect grain stocks and oil quality today at 11 AM.

title: Microphone and Projector flickering in Audi-3 during lectures
description: The HDMI cable connector on the podium is loose causing the projector display to blink every 2 minutes. The wireless mic battery also drains within 15 minutes.

timeline.title: Complaint Logged
timeline.note: Awaiting initial review by AV dept.

title: Street Lights not functioning near Girls Hostel walkway
location: Pathway between Gate 2 and Girls Hostel Block 1
description: Three consecutive solar LED poles on the walkway are off. The pathway is pitch dark after 7:30 PM creating a serious safety risk for evening scholars returning from library.

timeline.title: Security Patrolling Deployed & Electrician Called
timeline.note: Guard stationed permanently on pathway tonight. Electrician scheduled to replace sensor today morning.
